description: Creates or updates one relay in Development from gemmein/relays/<name>.json's contents ({ name, trigger, actions }); explain_relay validates the same definition offline. A signing or receiver secret Gemmein makes for it is not returned here — the answer carries the dashboard link where the founder sees it once. A relay is what a founder may describe as 'when X happens, do Y' — or, with an app_call trigger and spend_credits as its first action, as 'booking a class costs a credit': the app calls it by name and the caller's own credits are taken before anything is written. Work the founder's own server charges for is a pipeline (put_ai_tool, provider external), not a relay's call_url.
name: put_relay
title: Save a relay
